Name: Secret Greenhouse (PIF)
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

[size=3]This is a PIF mod, adds a greenhouse by buying a door, or the decorative ones you can buy from Robin's shop, or from the wizard in the tunnel west of the bus stop, or any other PIF door. I have specially created PIF doors that pair well with my greenhouses or outdoor gardens, which you can find here: [size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28160]Dynamic Glass Doors for PIF Windows and Plants[/url][/size][/size]

Greenhouse with working bathroom and three small spaces for trees, the walls are furnishable, except for the glass wall and you can change the floors or wallpaper.
Version 1.0.3 now greenhouse grows with house upgrade, see images.
Requires Personal Indoor Farm (PIF)
Installation:Unzip and paste into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.

A big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/109248658]DeLiXxN[/url] who helped me with the content.

Have fun!

I thank in advance anyone who believes that my work deserves at least the time to give a thumbs up.


Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url]


If you appreciate my work could you buy me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi[/url] ?
